items.title: Component inclusions into the simplicial total site are continuous and cocontinuous, with explicit shriek functors
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file spaces-simplicial.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: Seven-part structural lemma (statement 969-991, proof 993-1083): continuity and cocontinuity are argued in both site variants, the adjoints are cited from Sites and Modules on Sites, and both shriek formulas are proved by an explicit degree-by-degree construction of the left Kan extension with the adjunction bijection written out in both directions (its inverse check is the proof's single 'we omit the arguments' at source line 1056, an auxiliary step recorded in the notes); exactness is read off the formulas. H2: elementary site-theoretic construction, no spectral machinery.
